title: The Body Language Signal That Makes You Look Unconfident (Stop Doing This)
script: Crossing your arms in a meeting doesn't just signal defensiveness — it actually makes you think less clearly. Research from Harvard shows that expansive postures increase testosterone and lower cortisol before high-stakes situations. The single worst body language habit costing you credibility: the self-touch夹 — touching your neck, hair, or face while speaking. It screams 'please validate me.' Instead, keep your hands visible and open. Palms slightly up signals openness and honesty. Palms down signals authority. Make the switch today.
